reviewBasis.method: Independent cell-by-cell reconciliation against current source/target hashes, production caller contexts, runtime locale behavior, and both review packets.
reviewBasis.processExposure: The blind reviewer disclosed one generic public search about Traditional Chinese wording. Its content was not accessed or relied on here; the exposure note reports no PR, candidate, or prior-review access and no proposal influence.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: 無法載入網格統計資料
proposalAudit.rationale: The Mesh caller requests mesh statistics data. “統計訊息” means statistics messages; “統計資料” names statistical data and keeps the Traditional Chinese mesh term.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: 無法載入待處理的請求
proposalAudit.rationale: The current “加載” is a Simplified-style choice in the Traditional Chinese locale; “載入” is the catalog’s established Traditional form. “待處理的請求” conveys pending requests.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: Không thể tải số liệu thống kê xuất bản của pod:
proposalAudit.rationale: In this PodDhtPublishingPanel caller, “nhóm” changes the product entity pod into a generic group. Nearby Vietnamese pod messages retain “pod”; the proposal preserves that product term.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: Não foi possível carregar as salas em que você entrou
proposalAudit.rationale: The Rooms caller sets joined-room load errors. “Salas acessadas” can describe rooms merely visited; “salas em que você entrou” states the membership/join relationship naturally in Brazilian Portuguese.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: 無法載入網格統計資料
proposalAudit.rationale: The Mesh caller requests mesh statistics data. “統計訊息” means statistics messages; “統計資料” names statistical data and keeps the Traditional Chinese mesh term.

proposalAudit.submittedTarget: Không thể tải số liệu thống kê xuất bản của pod:
proposalAudit.rationale: In this PodDhtPublishingPanel caller, “nhóm” changes the product entity pod into a generic group. Nearby Vietnamese pod messages retain “pod”; the proposal preserves that product term.

disagreements.summary: Endorsed the blind target because the caller tracks rooms joined; “salas acessadas” may imply rooms merely visited.
Endorsed the primary target: use the Traditional Chinese “載入” form instead of “加載.”
Both reviewers proposed the same target; cross-review classifies the generic “nhóm” to product-specific “pod” change as a correction.
